Scene:
神农和他的家人住在古代，所以不知道什么植物能吃。因为他的家人常常生病了，所以神农和他的哥哥一起去旅行找可以吃的植物。他们去很多不一样的地方，比方说高山、山谷和沙漠。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 神农和他的家人住在古代：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
- 因为他的家人常常生病了：常常生病，no了for routine/habit
- 他们去很多不一样的地方：去了，了completed

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Coherence (Reference): 神农：一个叫神农的人，This is the character’s first mention, so introduce him with a full noun phrase rather than only assuming the reader already knows who he is. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
Run 2: Coherence (Reference): 神农和他的家人：一个叫神农的人和他的家人，On a character’s first mention, briefly introduce who the person is rather than using only a name. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
Run 3: 神农和他的家人住在古代，所以不知道什么植物能吃。：“在古代，神农和他的家人不知道什么植物能吃。” Ancient times is a time setting, not a place where someone “lives,” so use the time expression at the beginning of the sentence. [rule: time_expression]

output.reason: Runs 1 and 2 address the first-mention introduction of 神农, while Run 3 changes the time-expression wording instead.
